svg.title: Oseille — Rumex acetosa
svg.desc: A common sorrel specimen with long-stalked oblong arrow-shaped basal leaves, their two pointed lobes turned distinctly backwards. A slender erect jointed stem carries an open, irregularly branched panicle of minute green and muted rusty-red flowers and three-valved fruits. Fine veins, sparse curved hatching, papery stem sheaths and a tapering root are rendered as a botanical engraving with translucent sage washes.
